messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (about 0.1 atm), pure water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
This is a slight depression from the normal 0 °C freezing point at 1 atm; the phase‑diagram of water shows the solid–liquid equilibrium line dropping to about –2 °C when the pressure is reduced to ~10 kPa.
